heading.en: A coil that fights its own changes

hook.en: Switch off a large motor and you may see a spark jump at the switch. The coil's own collapsing current induces a large emf that tries to keep the current going. This is self-induction.
hook.kn: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಆಫ್ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಸ್ವಿಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿಡಿ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು. ಸುರುಳಿಯ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರೇರಿಸಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ಸ್ವಪ್ರೇರಣೆ.

objectives.en: Define mutual and self-inductance and find them for solenoids.
Find the energy stored in an inductor.

narration.en: Switch off a large motor and you may see a spark jump at the switch. The coil's own collapsing current induces a large emf that tries to keep the current going. This is self-induction.
narration.kn: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಆಫ್ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಸ್ವಿಚ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿಡಿ ಕಾಣಬಹುದು. ಸುರುಳಿಯ ಕುಸಿಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರೇರಿಸಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹವನ್ನು ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದೇ ಸ್ವಪ್ರೇರಣೆ.

body.en: When current I₁ in coil 1 sends flux through coil 2, the flux linkage is $N_2\Phi_2 = MI_1$, where M is the mutual inductance. A changing I₁ induces $\varepsilon_2 = -M\,dI_1/dt$ in coil 2. For two long coaxial solenoids of length l (inner radius r₁, turns per metre n₁ and n₂): $M = \mu_0n_1n_2\pi r_1^2l$. M₁₂ = M₂₁. Unit: henry (1 H = 1 V s A⁻¹).
body.kn: ಒಂದು ಸುರುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಸುರುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಪ್ರೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ε₂ = −M dI₁/dt. ಏಕಾಕ್ಷ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ M = μ₀n₁n₂πr₁²l. ಏಕಮಾನ ಹೆನ್ರಿ.

narration.en: When a changing current in one coil induces an emf in a nearby coil, the coils have mutual inductance M. The induced emf is minus M times the rate of change of current. For coaxial solenoids M is mu nought n1 n2 pi r1 squared l.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಸುರುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಸುರುಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ಪ್ರೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ε₂ = −M dI₁/dt. ಏಕಾಕ್ಷ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ M = μ₀n₁n₂πr₁²l. ಏಕಮಾನ ಹೆನ್ರಿ.

body.en: A coil's own current produces flux linkage NΦ = LI, where L is its self-inductance. A changing current induces a back emf $\varepsilon = -L\,dI/dt$ that opposes the change. For a long solenoid: $L = \mu_0n^2Al$ (multiplied by μ_r with a magnetic core). The work done against the back emf is stored as magnetic energy $U = \frac12LI^2$: inductance plays the role of mass for current.
body.kn: ಸುರುಳಿಯ ತನ್ನದೇ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ε = −L dI/dt ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗೆ L = μ₀n²Al. ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿತ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = ½LI².

narration.en: A coil's own changing current induces a back emf, minus L dI by dt. For a solenoid L is mu nought n squared A l. The energy stored is half L I squared, just like half m v squared.
narration.kn: ಸುರುಳಿಯ ತನ್ನದೇ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಪ್ರವಾಹ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ವಿ.ಚಾ.ಬ. ε = −L dI/dt ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗೆ L = μ₀n²Al. ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿತ ಶಕ್ತಿ U = ½LI².

problem.en: The current in a coil of self-inductance 0.2 H falls steadily from 5 A to 1 A in 0.1 s. Find the induced emf.

steps.en: ε = 8 V, acting to keep the current flowing.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. The current in a coil of self-inductance 0.2 H falls steadily from 5 A to 1 A in 0.1 s. Find the induced emf.

problem.en: A solenoid 0.5 m long has 500 turns and cross-section 4 × 10⁻⁴ m². Find its self-inductance and the energy stored when it carries 2 A.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A solenoid 0.5 m long has 500 turns and cross-section 4 × 10⁻⁴ m². Find its self-inductance and the energy stored when it carries 2 A.

body.en: For a coil of fixed length and area, L ∝ N². Double the turns and L becomes four times. Both the field (∝ N) and the number of turns linked (N) double.

narration.en: L grows as N². For a coil of fixed length and area, L ∝ N². Double the turns and L becomes four times. Both the field (∝ N) and the number of turns linked (N) double.

narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವು ಮೆಲ್ಲನೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two competitive exam pattern questions. Read carefully, then choose.

points.en: Mutual: ε₂ = −M dI₁/dt; M = μ₀n₁n₂πr₁²l for coaxial solenoids.
points.kn: ಅನ್ಯೋನ್ಯ: ε₂ = −M dI₁/dt; ಏಕಾಕ್ಷ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ M = μ₀n₁n₂πr₁²l.

points.en: Self: ε = −L dI/dt; L = μ₀n²Al for a solenoid.
points.kn: ಸ್ವ: ε = −L dI/dt; ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗೆ L = μ₀n²Al.

points.en: Energy stored in an inductor: ½LI².

homework.en: Two coaxial solenoids are 0.5 m long; the inner one has radius 1 cm and 1000 turns m⁻¹, the outer one 2000 turns m⁻¹. Find their mutual inductance.

narration.en: Recap. Mutual: ε₂ = −M dI₁/dt; M = μ₀n₁n₂πr₁²l for coaxial solenoids. Self: ε = −L dI/dt; L = μ₀n²Al for a solenoid. Energy stored in an inductor: ½LI².
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಅನ್ಯೋನ್ಯ: ε₂ = −M dI₁/dt; ಏಕಾಕ್ಷ ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ M = μ₀n₁n₂πr₁²l. ಸ್ವ: ε = −L dI/dt; ಸೊಲೆನಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗೆ L = μ₀n²Al. ಪ್ರೇರಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿತ ಶಕ್ತಿ: ½LI².
